forgiving_opening_tft
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperate on the first two turns, then mirror the opponent’s previous action. This preserves mutual cooperation with cooperative opponents while repairing interactions with opponents that begin with a single defensive defection; the one additional opening cooperation has negligible cost against persistent defectors in long matches.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) < 2 else opponent_history[-1]
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
